compliance_findings.citation: US state privacy law (CCPA/CPRA) · cookie consent
compliance_findings.fix: Tamazia installs a consent platform that blocks every non-essential tracker until opt-in, with a Reject-All button as prominent as Accept-All.
compliance_findings.fact: 1 non-essential tracker(s) load with no detectable consent mechanism: Meta Pixel (sets lu, xs, c_user — Advertising, controller Facebook).

compliance_findings.fix: Tamazia maps each market to its regime and closes the gaps.
compliance_findings.fact: Operates across 3 regions (US, Middle East, Global) on one-size-fits-all compliance.
